vibe: Premium, cinematic, expensive, aerodynamic, dark mood

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Glassmorphism: bg-[#0A0A0B]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 shadow-sm
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Solid background #0A0A0B with 1px border-white/10, hover:border-white/30 transition-all duration-300
surfaces_and_micro_themes.admin_cards: Flat background #0A0A0B, 1px border-border, no shadow, dense padding p-4
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: bg-[#E63946] text-white hover:bg-[#F05662] transition-colors rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-bold tracking-widest text-sm uppercase

marketing.hero: Full height 100vh with cinematic dark image, bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/50 to-transparent overlay. Large typography, bottom-left aligned content.
marketing.about: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). Asymmetric image placement. Large textual numbers.
marketing.catalog: Horizontal scroll or irregular grid for car cards. Do not use generic Shadcn cards. Build custom minimal cards. Image height max 60vh. Hover effects scale image.
marketing.europe_selection: Dark section with slow-moving Marquee 'MÜNCHEN • STUTTGART • BERLIN' in background. Use a striking mountain/driving image.
marketing.contact: Shadcn heavily customized forms. Floating labels, dark inputs with 1px border-white/20, focus:border-white.

admin.layout: Sidebar navigation (dark), 'Control Room' grid (Mode B) for dashboard metrics. Dense tables for car catalog and form submissions.
admin.primitives: Use Shadcn Table, Dialog, Select, DropdownMenu, Tabs. Style them with sharp corners, 1px border, dark mode defaults.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Momentum and weight are critical for luxury feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered fade-up. Use y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Images in cards scale by 1.05. Buttons have color shift. Borders on cards lighten from 10% to 30% white.

hero_bg.description: Dark blue SUV in studio. Put behind a dark gradient overlay.

about_image.description: Luxury car interior with red seats.

europe_service_bg.description: Black convertible parked on European mountain road.
europe_service_bg.placement: Car Selection from Europe Section Background or Side Image

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, forms, and cards MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern luxury dark theme landing page using React + TailwindCSS.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn Card layouts for the marketing pages. Build custom minimal rectangular containers with 1px borders and sharp/slight radius.
For Typography, import 'Cabinet Grotesk' via fontshare or google fonts, and 'Outfit'. Apply them in tailwind.config.js.
Implement smooth scrolling using @studio-freight/lenis or framer-motion.
Create two main routes: '/' (Landing Page) and '/admin' (Admin Dashboard).
The Hero section must have a gradient overlay to ensure text is readable over the dark car image.
Use react-fast-marquee for the background text in the Europe Selection service section.
The Admin dashboard should use Shadcn Table and UI primitives, following the 'Control Room' grid layout.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all interactive elements.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use only the Unsplash media links provided in these guidelines.
